summary: Griffon Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a joint venture involving its AMES U.S. and Canada businesses with Venanpri Tools, majority-owned by ONCAP. The JV closed on June 9, 2026, under an amended master transaction agreement. Griffon received $100M cash, $161.1M in second lien term loans (Tranche A $90M, Tranche B $71.1M), and a 42.78% equity stake in the buyer. This is a joint venture formation, not a classic acquisition or divestiture; watch for future operational updates and potential liquidity events.
